title: Singapore public holidays 2026
text: 2026-01-01 Thu New Year's Day. 2026-02-17 Tue and 2026-02-18 Wed Chinese New Year. 2026-03-21 Sat Hari Raya Puasa. 2026-04-03 Fri Good Friday. 2026-05-01 Fri Labour Day. 2026-05-27 Wed Hari Raya Haji. 2026-05-31 Sun Vesak Day; Mon 2026-06-01 is a public holiday. 2026-08-09 Sun National Day; Mon 2026-08-10 is a public holiday. 2026-11-08 Sun Deepavali; Mon 2026-11-09 is a public holiday. 2026-12-25 Fri Christmas Day. No public holiday falls between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-06.
